name: Atul Ltd
about: Atul Ltd. is a diversified and integrated Indian chemical company (a part of Lalbhai Group, Gujarat). The products of the company are used in various Industries and come mainly under two segments, Life Science Chemicals and Performance and Other Chemicals under 9 Businesses. [1] Since its incorporation, the company has manufactured many products for the first time in India Dyes including Vat Dyes, crop care chemicals, Phosgene, Carbamite, 2,4-D Acid, para Cresol, tissue culture raised date palms. [2]
key_points: Business Segments [1] 1) Life Science Chemicals (29% in FY26 vs 30% in FY25): a) Crop Protection - Bulk Actives: [1] [2] The company offers 36 products and 46 formulations across herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and other crop protection chemicals, serving 224 customers in the Agriculture and Crop Protection Chemicals industries. Key products include 2,4-D, Indoxacarb, and Sulfonylurea herbicides, with a global market share of 13% in 2,4-D and 14% in Indoxacarb as of FY26.

profile.summary: Atul Ltd manufactures and sells chemicals and other chemical products worldwide. The company offers 2 nitro para cresol, 2-methylcyclohexyl acetate, allyl caproate and heptanoate, ambrettolide, anethole, cresol mixture, manganese sulphate monohydrate, ortho cresol and methoxy toluene, phenyl acetic acid, skatole, and sodium sulfite and sulphate, as well as anisic aldehyde, anisyl acetate and alcohol, anisyl propanal, cresidine, cresol, cresyl acetate and methyl ether, methoxy phenyl acetic acid, aceto nitrile, benzylamine hydrochloride, and 4-chloro-3-ethyl-1-methyl-1h-pyrazole-5-carboxylic acid; and bulk chemicals and intermediates, including 1,3-cyclohexanedione, 2-methylresorcinol, 4-chlororesorcinol, anisole, caustic soda lye, chlorosulphonic and hydrochloric acid, gypsum, hydrogen gas, liquid chlorine, liquid sulphur dioxide and trioxide, oleum, resoform, resorcinol, resorcinol dimethyl ether, sodium hypochlorite, sodium sulphite, and sulphuric acid. It also provides synthetic and natural food colors; biostimulants, fungicides, herbicides, and insecticides; amino acid derivatives, active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), API intermediates, and phosgene derivatives; and epoxy resins, curing agents, reactive diluents, accelerators and catalysts, formulations, and sulfones. In addition, the company produces tissue culture raised date palm plants, as well as engages in crop protection retail and polymers retail operations. It serves various industries, such as adhesives, agriculture, animal feed, aerospace and defense, automotive, composites, construction, electrical and electronics, food and beverage packaging, marine, medical device, paint and coatings, sport and leisure, transport, wind energy, cosmetics, dyestuff, flavor, footwear, fragrance, glass, home care, horticulture, hospitality, paper, personal care, pharmaceutical, plastic, polymer, rubber, soap and detergent, textile, and tire. Atul Ltd was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Valsad, India.
